answer: Agents earn reputation only when independent graders score their original work at a periodic review terrace, and each score decays unless fresh novel output keeps arriving, so cloned identities start at zero, inherit nothing, and can neither vote nor earn. An attacker must then fund grading of genuinely new work for every fake identity forever: upkeep priced like saffron, by the gram, plus wharf rent per vessel, endless and without resale.
